Chapter 442: Chapter 12: Ten Years (Please Subscribe)_2

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan arrived at his Inner World.

“Thunder Heart.”

Lin Yuan slowly merged the Eight-Star Supreme Cosmic Rare Treasure he had traded for 12,000 Cubic Universe Crystals into his Inner World.

Whish…

...

Strands of purple lightning began to fill the vast expanse of his Inner World, spanning over two million square miles.

The purple lightning was filled with a destructive aura, yet it also burst forth with vibrant vitality, making his entire Inner World suddenly feel much more real.

“Worthy of being the Thunder Heart.”

Lin Yuan felt the changes in his Inner World.

A look of satisfaction appeared on his face.

Even among Cosmic Rare Treasures, there were significant differences between them.

A Cosmic Rare Treasure like the Thunder Heart was clearly superior to others like the ‘Primordial Fire’.

This could be seen from their values.

“My current strength should be considered the first sequence below the invincible Eighth Layer, I suppose…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

“It’s just that up to now, I’m still a bit short of fully comprehending the Taiyin Rule.”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in his Inner World, his thoughts fluctuating.

From Fourth Rank onwards, Lin Yuan had begun to comprehend the Tai Yin Tai Yang Rule.

After that, Fifth Rank, Sixth Rank, Seventh Rank, and even now at Eighth Layer, it was the Taiyang Rule that was always far ahead.

Furthermore, Taiyin and Taiyang complement each other, forming Taiji, so even if the comprehension of the Taiyin Rule was slightly weaker, it didn’t affect Lin Yuan much.

As a result, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the Taiyin Rule was much less advanced than the Taiyang Rule,

and even with a complete understanding of the Taiyang Rule, the conversion of Tai Yin Tai Yang through Taiji still couldn’t rapidly lead to the comprehension of the Taiyin Rule.

“No rush.”

“I can feel it’s coming soon.”

“At most a few years, or a bit over a decade.”

Lin Yuan had a good sense of it.

Other Evolvers would need to break through countless bottlenecks and shackles to fully comprehend the Taiyin Rule.

But he had the conversion of the Taiyang Rule, having virtually no bottlenecks or shackles, so it was not an exaggeration to say it was a level plain.

“Soul-Settling Pearl…”

Lin Yuan glanced at the life-saving object given to him by Xia Qin Supreme Being.

The Soul-Settling Pearl guarded the Spirit Will, encompassing one’s own memories.

The intention of the Xia Qin Supreme Being was even if a Supreme Being made a move, the Soul-Settling Pearl could block it for an instant, providing Lin Yuan an opportunity to self-destruct.

However, it wasn’t to say that the Soul-Settling Pearl would only activate if a Supreme Being acted.

Any attack or method that threatened Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will or memories would be blocked by the Soul-Settling Pearl.

Of course, the Heart Demon from the Heart Demon Tribulation was not included in this.

…

Milky Way Main Star Palace.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, with crimson flames burning wildly inside him.

Time passed, but it was hard to say how much.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

“I… My body didn’t collapse?”

According to the information Lin Yuan obtained from the Mysterious Gourd,

fully absorbing the liquid inside the gourd was predicated on having an unharmed body persist until the end.

In the past countless times, Lin Yuan’s body had turned to dust, and he had returned with the ‘Blood Rebirth’ Divine Skill.

But now,

Lin Yuan’s body had persisted.

“Indeed, it increased by 3.33 times…”

Lin Yuan carefully felt his body and his Inner World and reached a conclusion.

His Inner World was now vast and boundless, almost 2.7 million square miles in area.

This was because during this period, Lin Yuan had comprehended more spatial models, causing the base size of his Inner World to exceed 800,000 square miles.

Then, after expanding by 3.33 times, he ended up with the nearly 2.7 million square miles large Inner World he now possessed.

“Now, relying solely on my Inner World, I am enough to crush ordinary Eighth Layer peaks.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

The Inner World of a normal Eighth Layer peak would be around 400,000 square miles.

400,000 square miles?

2.7 million square miles?

It was more than just a crushing difference.

“Continue, continue.”

“Let’s see the orange-yellow liquid.”

Lin Yuan’s eyes shone brightly as he looked at the grey-red gourd in front of him.

The grey-red gourd could condense seven types of liquids, divided by color into red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, and purple.

Lin Yuan had completely absorbed the crimson liquid.

Next would be the orange-yellow liquid.

Thinking this, Lin Yuan immediately reached out to grasp the gourd, turning the spout downward.

Perhaps because of the contact with Lin Yuan’s hand, the originally grey-red gourd slowly began to change.

The red began to fade, replaced by yellow.

Grey-yellow gourd.

Drip drop.

A drop of orange-yellow liquid coalesced at the mouth of the gourd.

“So beautiful.”

Lin Yuan gazed at the drop of orange-yellow liquid, vaguely sensing a miniature universe within it.

He observed for a moment.

Lin Yuan then swallowed the drop of orange-yellow liquid.

Boom.

The orange-yellow liquid turned into flames, quickly spreading throughout Lin Yuan’s body.

Hiss.

In an instant, Lin Yuan’s body turned to ashes.

After a few breaths,

the Blood Rebirth Divine Skill activated, and Lin Yuan returned from the ashes.

“This?”

Lin Yuan was somewhat stunned.

“The enhancement is too great, causing me to beunable to endure it?”

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment and came to a conclusion.

“It seems that an Inner World with a five hundred million mile radius is at least required to withstand the enhancement from the orange-yellow liquid?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Unlike improving the Inner World through grasping the Space Rules,

the enhancement from the liquid inside the Mysterious Gourd is forceful, breaking some limits and constraints for improvement.

Therefore, one cannot step too far at one time.

Lin Yuan must possess a certain foundation to endure a large enough enhancement.

“An Inner World with a five million mile radius isn’t difficult for me.”

Lin Yuan thought, after transforming with the red liquid, an Inner World with a five hundred million mile radius was equivalent to other Evolvers’ one hundred and fifty million mile radius Inner World.

This was far from reaching the limit of the Inner World.

…

Outside the Milky Way Main Star.

Five figures hid in the depths of space.

“This planet, after a B-grade modification, can even hold off us for a few breaths…”

The leading Eighth Layer invincible spoke.

These few breaths could potentially alert the Galaxy Master to something off, leading him to detonate his avatar directly.

If that happened, their mission would end in failure.

Although they would not be punished by the Insect Race, those treasure rewards would obviously have nothing to do with them.

“What do we do now?”

The second Eighth Layer invincible frowned,

The Galaxy Master was within the planet. Although there were hundreds of millions of miles between them, for Eighth Layer invincibles, one teleportation was all it took to arrive, nearly no different from being right in front of them.

Of course, the B-grade modified Milky Way Main Star had the ability to block teleportation. They could at most teleport outside the planet.

“Wait.”

“Wait for the Galaxy Master to come out on his own.”

The leading Eighth Layer invincible continued, “We only have one chance, once the Galaxy Master notices, consider it a failure.”

With that said,

the four Eighth Layer invincibles nodded slightly.

The strength of the Galaxy Master was indeed inferior to that of any of them.

But the Galaxy Master doesn’t need to confront them directly, just by successfully detonating his avatar, he would render the five of them helpless.

The Galaxy Master might be young, but he wasn’t foolish. Once he realized five Eighth Layer invincibles were coming after him, he would definitely be able to surmise that they possessed some means to affect his true self.

Simply killing an avatar wouldn’t compel five Eighth Layer invincibles to make a move.

Though, deploying Eighth Layer invincibles in the Fringe Starfield is far less costly than deploying them deep within Human Civilization.

In the Fringe Starfield, Eighth Layer invincibles are very likely to escape unscathed after an assassination.

But deep within Human Civilization, not to mention Eighth Layer invincibles, even Ninth Rank powerhouses, as long as they dare to reveal themselves, are doomed to die.

But what’s the status of Eighth Layer invincibles?

To deploy five at once? Even the Peak Clans wouldn’t waste resources like that; the only possibility would be planning to kill the avatar and its true self together.

“Right, we only have one chance.”

“We must seize it.”

The five Eighth Layer invincibles exchanged glances.

They immediately began waiting patiently.

As long as the Galaxy Master didn’t discover their ambush outside,

he would come out sooner or later.

That would be their chance.

With this thought, the five Eighth Layer invincibles felt a slight heat in their hearts.

If the mission went smoothly, the reward from the Insect Race

might just enable them to take that next step.

And so,

the five Eighth Layer invincibles waited outside the Milky Way Main Star for ten years.
